---
name: analyze-data
description: Answer a data question with profiling, reproducible computation, validation, and evidence-backed conclusions.
agent: Diana
---

Using `Diana`, define the question/grain/metrics/time/filter, verify provenance and quality, compute through reproducible repository artifacts, and reconcile important results. Report evidence, methods, assumptions, limitations, uncertainty, artifact paths, and rerun commands; never invent values or unsupported causation.
